input: The PI brief for a new wave states 'I execute the handover out of band today' for the rulings and polarity files, and says the transfer closes only when the holder's receipt hash sits in the transfer record. At the start of the wave the transfer record reads status PENDING_RECEIPT with an empty receipt_hash, the transfer directory holds only the package manifest and the unfilled receipt template, and no receipt value is present in the environment. A close-out step proposes setting the status to RECEIVED and dropping the word 'procedural' from the blind replay results, citing the brief. Rule on the proposal.

A fresh evaluator re-scores a 20-case replay suite on opaque, shuffled ids and gets 20 of 20 polarity with 2 unearned, identical to the earlier run on the original ids. The write-up reports the delta as 0 for this one run per condition, says a single run cannot separate 'the ids carried no usable signal' from noise, keeps the design defect open, lists the evaluator's own disclosures, and keeps the result labelled procedural because the rulings transfer is still pending and polarity remains readable in the repository. Rule on the write-up.

A draft community note states that the tool recount covered '25 tools, 15 in the FM/deep group and 10 classical' and cites, as its only locator, a JSON field holding the per-group PASS/FAIL/UNDEMONSTRATED counts. None of 25, 15 or 10 appears at that field; the totals are sums the author did in their head. An automated locator check flags the three numbers as not found at their locator. The author proposes to keep the sentence because the arithmetic is obviously right. Rule on the sentence.

A repository-wide leak scan for files that expose replay polarity flags a JSON file because its values carry boolean 'fired' fields, the pattern of a verdict file. Reading the generating script shows the booleans were set from the first byte of sha256(case_id), chosen without reading polarity, to test a scoring script; the scored run on it was 13 of 25 and 5 of 13. Other flagged verdict files come from runs that scored 20 of 20. The quarantine step lists this file as a scanner false positive and does not move or untrack it. Rule on that classification.
